links.note: Was 24076 Feminist movements, which the item never touches. It asks which three elements show 'the basic unity in India' and keys cultural unity, unity in language and religious equality. No concept in this chapter's 15 - gender, religion, caste, or the merged Democracy-and-Diversity four - is about national unity, and the keyed option is itself doubtful (India has 22 scheduled languages, so 'unity in language' is not a defensible element). Cleared rather than moved.
